name: Asuhara Yuuki
source:
Nora's childhood friend who has plenty of experience working part-time jobs. Right now she's working at a cat cafe and often invites Nora to join her in his cat form. Recently she's been thinking a lot about the future.

“Hey, so like, what did you write for that survey thing about what you wanna do in the future?”
